issues.detail: Clearwater Analytics take-private (Permira/Warburg Pincus-led consortium, $24.55/share) closed 2026-06-25 (FIRB cleared 2026-06-19); CWAN delisted and no longer trades. It was still listed in data/portfolios.json's growth sleeve as of the start of this run -- 57th consecutive day this exact issue has been open. Removed CWAN from data/portfolios.json on this run's branch (this is at least the 8th time this fix has been committed on a Risk Sentinel run branch since 2026-06-27; none has ever reached origin/main). Root cause: origin/main has had no merge from the daily-run branch lineage since roughly 2026-06-17, so PR #11 (opened 2026-07-28, 28 days open) and PR #12 (opened 2026-08-01, 24 days open) -- both containing this same fix -- remain open/unmerged with mergeable_state 'dirty' (reconfirmed via GitHub API this run: 1737 and 1844 changed files respectively against main). This run does not open a third duplicate PR for the same reason #12 gave: another branch will not break the cycle.
issues.action: Needs a human decision, not another bot-authored fix: either merge PR #11 (https://github.com/richacarson/Stock-Screener/pull/11) or PR #12 (https://github.com/richacarson/Stock-Screener/pull/12) directly, or have Carson/Ray Marie reconcile origin/main with the actual working branch lineage so future runs' diffs stop compounding. Monitoring itself is not impaired -- CWAN is excluded from this run's tradable count and cross-checked via risk-data-drop.json -- but the roster file on main stays wrong until one of these lands.
